mapper.select: SELECT r.*, u.nick_name AS authorName, u.avatar AS authorAvatar, COALESCE(f.cnt, 0) AS favoriteCount FROM recipe r LEFT JOIN user u ON r.author_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT recipe_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM favorite GROUP BY recipe_id ) f ON r.recipe_id = f.recipe_id WHERE r.status = 1 AND (r.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR r.description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) ORDER BY r.like_count DESC
